sentences.en: The spokesman explained the blueprint of the scheme to the press.
sentences.zh: 这位发言人向媒体解释了该方案的蓝图。

sentences.en: Mick, let me see your blueprint for the Nelsons' detached house.
sentences.zh: 米克，让我看看你为尼尔森家独立屋制定的方案吧。

sentences.en: The architect drew blueprints of the house.
sentences.zh: 建筑师画出了这座房子的平面图。

mnemonic: 合成词：blue（蓝）+print（印刷的图）→蓝图
